GLP-1 The Key Behind Weight Loss

Obesity is a sub-health issue that plagues many people today, and the history of humanity's struggle with obesity is also the history of the development of weight-loss drugs.

Appetite Remote Control in the Gut How Specific Microbiota Regulate Brain Feeding Behavior

Microbiota in the gut are most abundant in the colon and largely regulate feeding behavior, possibly through neuroregulators, immune signals, and the vagal nerve pathway. However, it remains unclear how the host interprets microbial sensory information via direct neural circuits to adjust its own feeding behavior.

Hypotheses of Alzheimer’s Disease (AD) Pathogenesis

Currently, researchers have proposed several hypotheses regarding the pathogenesis of Alzheimer’s disease (AD). However, due to the complexity and heterogeneity of AD pathology, constructing a comprehensive theoretical framework remains highly challenging. This article will briefly introduce several major hypotheses proposed by researchers and discuss the current status of AD drug research and development.

Our Pipeline

Our Company

Our company is dedicated to tackling some of the world’s most urgent health challenges—Alzheimer’s disease, obesity, and diabetes.

With a strong portfolio of patents, we deliver cutting-edge solutions that move beyond conventional treatments.

In Alzheimer’s disease, our proprietary technologies aim to enhance cognitive function through novel, targeted mechanisms.

For obesity and diabetes, we have developed breakthrough approaches that optimize key proteins, offering results similar to GLP-1 therapies—helping to regulate blood sugar and support effective weight management.

These innovations reflect our commitment to transforming scientific discovery into meaningful health outcomes, shaping a healthier future for patients worldwide.

We are advancing six pipelines in innovative drug development targeting Alzheimer’s disease, type 2 diabetes, obesity, depression, and anxiety.
